#Set Working Directory & Load Packages
```{r}
#set working directory
setwd("~/Desktop/blameassignment")

#load packages
library(psych)
library(effects)
library(corrplot)
library(corrgram)
library(stats)
library(plotrix)
library(plyr)
library(dplyr)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

```

#Load in Anonymized Data (this is the file available on OSF)
```{r}
#load in data frame
qualtrics <- read.csv("Blame Assignment Study 4 Anon.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

#no headers
df <- qualtrics %>%
  filter(DistributionChannel == "anonymous") #1272 entries

#frequency of each ID
df.duplicateIDs <- df %>% 
  group_by(anon_id) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(freq=n())

#df that has only unique IDs
df.unique <- df.duplicateIDs %>%
  filter(freq == 1)

#only retain rows in original data file that are in the "unique" df
df.2 <- 
  df %>% 
  filter(anon_id %in% c(df.unique$anon_id))

#filter out anyone who is not American
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(citizenship == 1)

#filter out anyone who did not identity as white or black
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(race == 1 | race == 2)

#filter out those who failed attention check
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(unpackedwhite1_check == 3 | unpackedblack1_check == 3 | unpackedwhite2_check == 1 | unpackedblack2_check == 1 | unpackedwhite3_check == 2 | unpackedblack3_check == 2)

#filter out those who did not consent
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(consent==1)

```

#Data Cleaning
```{r}
#delete Qualtrics columns
df.2$StartDate <- NULL
df.2$EndDate <- NULL
df.2$Status <- NULL
df.2$IPAddress <- NULL
df.2$Progress <- NULL
df.2$Duration..in.seconds. <- NULL
df.2$Finished <- NULL
df.2$RecordedDate <- NULL
df.2$ResponseId <- NULL
df.2$RecipientLastName <- NULL
df.2$RecipientFirstName <- NULL
df.2$RecipientEmail <- NULL
df.2$ExternalReference <- NULL
df.2$LocationLatitude <- NULL
df.2$LocationLongitude <- NULL
df.2$DistributionChannel <- NULL
df.2$UserLanguage <- NULL

#turn all blanks to NA
df.2 <- df.2 %>% mutate_all(na_if,"")

```

#Make Condition Variable
```{r}
#condition
df.2$condition <- rep(NA,nrow(df.2))

df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$unpackedwhite1_1)] <- 1 #unpacked whites without anchor
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$unpackedblack1_1)] <- 2 #unpacked blacks without anchor
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$unpackedwhite2_1)] <- 3 #unpacked whites with equal proportions anchor
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$unpackedblack2_1)] <- 4 #unpacked blacks with equal proportions anchor
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$unpackedwhite3_1)] <- 5 #unpacked whites with 100% anchor
df.2$condition[!is.na(df.2$unpackedblack3_1)] <- 6 #unpacked blacks with 100% anchor

table(df.2$condition)

```

#Finalize Clean Data
```{r}
#create new data frame
df.3 <- df.2

#check consent
table(df.3$consent)

#check conditions
table(df.3$condition)

#turn all variables to numeric
df.4 <- data.frame(lapply(df.3, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))))

```

#Data Demographics
```{r}
#gender
tablegender <- table(df.4$gender)
prop.table(tablegender)*100

#age
df.4 %>% summarize(mean_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_age=sd(age, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_age=sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_age=mean(age, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(age, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

#race
tablerace <- table(df.4$race)
prop.table(tablerace)*100

```

#Create Blame Variables
```{r}
#Condition 1: unpacked whites without anchor
#Condition 2: unpacked blacks without anchor
#Condition 3: unpacked whites with equal proportions anchor
#Condition 4: unpacked blacks with equal proportions anchor
#Condition 5: unpacked whites with 100% anchor
#Condition 6: unpacked blacks with 100% anchor


#Condition 1: unpacked whites without anchor
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c1_blameblack = unpackedwhite1_1)

#Condition 2: unpacked blacks without anchor
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c2_blameblack = unpackedblack1_2 + unpackedblack1_3 + unpackedblack1_4 + unpackedblack1_5 + unpackedblack1_6)

#Condition 3: unpacked whites with equal proportions anchor
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c3_blameblack = unpackedwhite2_1)

#Condition 4: unpacked blacks with equal proportions anchor
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c4_blameblack = unpackedblack2_2 + unpackedblack2_3 + unpackedblack2_4 + unpackedblack2_5 + unpackedblack2_6)

#Condition 5: unpacked whites with 100% anchor
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c5_blameblack = unpackedwhite3_1)

#Condition 6: unpacked blacks with 100% anchor
df.4 <- df.4 %>% 
  mutate(c6_blameblack = unpackedblack3_2 + unpackedblack3_3 + unpackedblack3_4 + unpackedblack3_5 + unpackedblack3_6)


#blame blacks variable
df.4$blameblack <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$blameblack <- pmax(df.4$c1_blameblack, df.4$c2_blameblack, df.4$c3_blameblack, df.4$c4_blameblack, df.4$c5_blameblack, df.4$c6_blameblack, na.rm=TRUE)

summary(df.4$blameblack)

#blame whites variable
df.4$blamewhite <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$blamewhite <- 100-df.4$blameblack

summary(df.4$blamewhite)

```

#Analyses
```{r}
#Condition 1: unpacked whites without anchor
#Condition 2: unpacked blacks without anchor
#Condition 3: unpacked whites with equal proportions anchor
#Condition 4: unpacked blacks with equal proportions anchor
#Condition 5: unpacked whites with 100% anchor
#Condition 6: unpacked blacks with 100% anchor

#turn numeric variables into factors
df.4$condition <- as.factor(df.4$condition)
df.4$race <- as.factor(df.4$race)
df.4$politicalorientation <- as.factor(df.4$politicalorientation)

#make binary variable for unpacked blacks
df.4$binaryunpackedblack <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$binaryunpackedblack <- ifelse(df.4$condition==2 | df.4$condition==4 | df.4$condition==6, 1, 0)

df.4$binaryunpackedblack <- as.factor(df.4$binaryunpackedblack)

#make binary variable for unpacked whites
df.4$binaryunpackedwhite <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$binaryunpackedwhite <- ifelse(df.4$condition==1 | df.4$condition==3 | df.4$condition==5, 1, 0)

df.4$binaryunpackedwhite <- as.factor(df.4$binaryunpackedwhite)

#type of process intervention condition
df.4$anchortype <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$anchortype[df.4$condition==1 | df.4$condition==2] <- 1
df.4$anchortype[df.4$condition==3 | df.4$condition==4] <- 2
df.4$anchortype[df.4$condition==5 | df.4$condition==6] <- 3

df.4$anchortype <- as.factor(df.4$anchortype)

#set ANOVA defaults to SPSS defaults
options(contrasts = c("contr.helmert", "contr.poly"))
options("contrasts")

library(car)
library(sjstats)

#3 way ANOVA
anova1 <- lm(blameblack ~ binaryunpackedblack * anchortype * race, data = df.4)

Anova(anova1,type=3)

anova1effect <-Anova(anova1,type=3)
eta_sq(anova1effect, partial = T)

#2 way ANOVA
anova2 <- lm(blameblack ~ binaryunpackedblack * anchortype, data = df.4)

Anova(anova2,type=3)

anova2effect <-Anova(anova2,type=3)
eta_sq(anova2effect, partial = T)

#correlation
df.4$race <- as.numeric(df.4$race)

cor.test(df.4$race, df.4$blameblack)

df.4$race <- as.factor(df.4$race)

#summary statistics by condition
conditionsummarytable <- df.4 %>% dplyr::group_by(condition) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blameblack=mean(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blameblack=sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blameblack=sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blameblack=mean(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blameblack=mean(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

```

#online supplementary materials - chi squared test for attrition rates
```{r}
#data set without attention checks

#no headers
df <- qualtrics %>%
  slice(3:1274) %>%
  filter(DistributionChannel == "anonymous") #1272 entries

#frequency of each ID
df.duplicateIDs <- df %>% 
  group_by(PROLIFIC_PID) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(freq=n())

#df that has only unique IDs
df.unique <- df.duplicateIDs %>%
  filter(freq == 1)

#only retain rows in original data file that are in the "unique" df
df.2 <- 
  df %>% 
  filter(PROLIFIC_PID %in% c(df.unique$PROLIFIC_PID))

#filter out anyone who is not American
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(citizenship == 1)

#filter out anyone who did not identity as white or black
df.2 <- df.2 %>% 
  filter(race == 1 | race == 2)

df.attritionrates <- df.2

#turn all blanks to NA
df.attritionrates <- df.attritionrates %>% mutate_all(na_if,"")


#make condition variable
df.attritionrates$condition <- rep(NA,nrow(df.attritionrates))

df.attritionrates$condition[!is.na(df.attritionrates$unpackedwhite1_1)] <- 1 #unpacked whites without anchor
df.attritionrates$condition[!is.na(df.attritionrates$unpackedblack1_1)] <- 2 #unpacked blacks without anchor
df.attritionrates$condition[!is.na(df.attritionrates$unpackedwhite2_1)] <- 3 #unpacked whites with equal proportions anchor
df.attritionrates$condition[!is.na(df.attritionrates$unpackedblack2_1)] <- 4 #unpacked blacks with equal proportions anchor
df.attritionrates$condition[!is.na(df.attritionrates$unpackedwhite3_1)] <- 5 #unpacked whites with 100% anchor
df.attritionrates$condition[!is.na(df.attritionrates$unpackedblack3_1)] <- 6 #unpacked blacks with 100% anchor

table(df.attritionrates$condition)


#make anchor types variable
df.attritionrates$anchortype <- rep(NA,nrow(df.attritionrates))

df.attritionrates$anchortype[df.attritionrates$condition==1 | df.attritionrates$condition==2] <- 1
df.attritionrates$anchortype[df.attritionrates$condition==3 | df.attritionrates$condition==4] <- 2
df.attritionrates$anchortype[df.attritionrates$condition==5 | df.attritionrates$condition==6] <- 3

table(df.attritionrates$anchortype)


#make attention check variable (0 if failed, 1 if passed)
df.attritionrates$attncheck1 <- ifelse(df.attritionrates$unpackedwhite1_check==3,1,0)
df.attritionrates$attncheck2 <- ifelse(df.attritionrates$unpackedblack1_check==3,1,0)
df.attritionrates$attncheck3 <- ifelse(df.attritionrates$unpackedwhite2_check==1,1,0)
df.attritionrates$attncheck4 <- ifelse(df.attritionrates$unpackedblack2_check==1,1,0)
df.attritionrates$attncheck5 <- ifelse(df.attritionrates$unpackedwhite3_check==2,1,0)
df.attritionrates$attncheck6 <- ifelse(df.attritionrates$unpackedblack3_check==2,1,0)

df.attritionrates$attncheck <- rep(NA,nrow(df.attritionrates))

df.attritionrates$attncheck <- pmax(df.attritionrates$attncheck1, df.attritionrates$attncheck2, df.attritionrates$attncheck3, df.attritionrates$attncheck4, df.attritionrates$attncheck5, df.attritionrates$attncheck6, na.rm=TRUE)

table(df.attritionrates$attncheck)


#chi squared test
library(MASS)

df.attritionrates$anchortype <- as.factor(df.attritionrates$anchortype)
df.attritionrates$attncheck <- as.factor(df.attritionrates$attncheck)

tbl <- table(df.attritionrates$anchortype, df.attritionrates$attncheck)
tbl

chisq.test(tbl)

```

```{r}
#blame republicans variable
df.4$blamerep <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$blamerep <- pmax(df.4$c1_blamerep, df.4$c2_blamerep, df.4$c3_blamerep, df.4$c4_blamerep, df.4$c5_blamerep, df.4$c6_blamerep, na.rm=TRUE)

summary(df.4$blamerep)

#blame independents variable
df.4$blameind <- rep(NA,nrow(df.4))

df.4$blameind <- pmax(df.4$c1_blameind, df.4$c2_blameind, df.4$c3_blameind, df.4$c4_blameind, df.4$c5_blameind, df.4$c6_blameind, na.rm=TRUE)

summary(df.4$blameind)

#summary statistics
df.4 %>% dplyr::group_by(politicalorientation) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blamedem=mean(blamedem, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blamedem=sd(blamedem, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blamedem=sd(blamedem, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blamedem=mean(blamedem, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blamedem, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blamedem=mean(blamedem, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blamedem, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

df.4 %>% dplyr::group_by(politicalorientation) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blamerep=mean(blamerep, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blamerep=sd(blamerep, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blamerep=sd(blamerep, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blamerep=mean(blamerep, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blamerep, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blamerep=mean(blamerep, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blamerep, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

df.4 %>% dplyr::group_by(politicalorientation) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blameind=mean(blameind, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blameind=sd(blameind, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blameind=sd(blameind, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blameind=mean(blameind, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blameind, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blameind=mean(blameind, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blameind, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

#correlations
df.4$politicalorientation <- as.numeric(df.4$politicalorientation)

cor.test(df.4$politicalorientation, df.4$blamedem)

cor.test(df.4$politicalorientation, df.4$blamerep)

cor.test(df.4$politicalorientation, df.4$blameind)

```

#online supplementary materials - simple effects between anchor types
```{r}
#anchor type 1: no anchor
#anchor type 2: equal proportions anchor
#anchor type 3: 100% anchor

#2 way ANOVA
anova2 <- lm(blameblack ~ binaryunpackedblack * anchortype, data = df.4)

Anova(anova2,type=3)

anova2effect <-Anova(anova2,type=3)
eta_sq(anova2effect, partial = T)

#summary statistics
df.4 %>% dplyr::group_by(binaryunpackedblack, anchortype) %>% 
  summarize(mean_blameblack=mean(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_blameblack=sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE),
            se_blameblack=sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            lower_blameblack=mean(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE) - sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96,
            upper_blameblack=mean(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE) + sd(blameblack, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())*1.96)

#contrast codes & simple effects
df.4$binaryunpackedblack <- as.factor(df.4$binaryunpackedblack)
df.4$anchortype <- as.factor(df.4$anchortype)

contrasts(df.4$binaryunpackedblack) #0 is packed, 1 is unpacked
contrasts(df.4$anchortype) #1 is no anchor, 2 is equal proportions anchor, 3 is 100% anchor

contrasts(df.4$binaryunpackedblack) = cbind("_ref_packed" = c(0,1)) #packed is reference group

contrasts(df.4$anchortype) = cbind("_unequal_vs_baseline" = c(1,0,0), "_unequal_vs_equal" = c(0,1,0))

lm(blameblack ~ binaryunpackedblack * anchortype, data = df.4) %>% summary()

contrasts(df.4$binaryunpackedblack) = cbind("_ref_unpacked" = c(1,0)) #swap reference so unpacked is now reference group

lm(blameblack ~ binaryunpackedblack * anchortype, data = df.4) %>% summary()

```
